## Appearance

Isolde Pembroke is a lovely, small figure with rosy, flush cheeks marked with dimples, showcasing a vigorous complexion. She has dark, black eyes and dark, shiny raven hair worn in ringlets.

## Personality

Isolde Pembroke is a sweet, kind, and good individual who proves to be an exceptionally comforting companion. Inheriting a cheerful demeanor and look from her father, she is also characterized as faithful, practical, and lively. She possesses the remarkable trait of selflessly appreciating the talents and virtues of her friends. Skilled in culinary and craft endeavors, she can create a wonderful lettuce salad and construct popular bookmarkers using red tissue paper, though she harbors a persistent fear of being a dumpling. Her deepest desire is to be called 'mother' by her child, and she is firmly resolved to ensure his first memory of her is a pleasant one.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## History

Isolde Pembroke grew up in [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) and formed an instant, enduring bond with [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during their childhood. The girls attended [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together, where Isolde stood by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) through schoolyard turmoil and dramatic childhood fears. After her baby sister [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) contracted croup, Isolde rushed to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) for help, allowing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to nurse the infant until a doctor arrived. As they grew older, Isolde joined [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in starting a private school story club and later helped bring the news of Nell's top placement on her entrance exams. Throughout their youth, Isolde actively participated in the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), canvassing for donations and confronting [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) over advertisement leases. Their adventures together included discovering [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), searching for a rare willow-ware platter, and spending a rainy afternoon stranded near a duckhouse. Isolde eventually fell secretly in love with [Gideon](../character/gideon-duckett.md) and happily confided her engagement to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). She maintained her close bond with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) through her college years, offering feedback on Nell's early writing attempts and visiting [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) together. In a time of grief, Isolde joined [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in walking home after the funeral of their friend [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P0](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I am so happy that you have moved to Grey Shutters. Having a companion to play with will be wonderful. No other girls reside close enough for us to play together, and none of my sisters are old enough."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> "Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)

> “Yes,” Isolde replied, jerking her head back, “however, it is my belief that Julia Bell is not favored by him to such a high degree. I have listened to him state that he used her freckles to learn the multiplication table.”
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> "Really, he teases every single girl. He makes jokes about mine on account of it being so black. He has named me a crow twelve times; and prior to this, I also have not known him to offer an apology for anything."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I really believe you are unkind. What am I to do? Mr. Pidgeon is going to force me to be seated next to that dreadful Tibby Tulk—I am certain he will since no one is sitting beside her. Please return, Nell."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/isolde-pembroke--nell-harcourt.md)

Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are devoted schoolmates and close friends who quickly bond upon meeting at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) and vow to be best friends forever. Their deep attachment leads to shared daily visits, peaceful moments spending time together by the Nymph's Well, and high drama when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) heroically helps Isolde treat her baby sister [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) for croup during the night. Isolde also hosts parties that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) attends, and the two young women remain inseparable companions despite occasional childhood dramatic fears of future separation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P0](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), +76 more_
